ews.title: Subsea Pipeline Early Warning
ews.description: EWS status of vessels near pipeline corridors: safe, warning (≤ 1,750 m) and danger (≤ 500 m), using the predicted anchoring status.
capabilities: Map of pipeline corridors (geo zones) and vessels coloured by EWS status
Vessel details: distance to the pipeline, navigational status and track

collision.title: Collision Risk (CPA/TCPA)
collision.description: Vessel encounters with a risky closest point of approach (CPA) and time to CPA (TCPA).
capabilities: Map of encounters and CPA lines
Low / medium / high risk bands from the detector
